en: A vintage monochrome postcard view of people standing and fishing on rocky shoreline outcrops by the sea. The figures are dressed in late 19th–early 20th century clothing, including long dresses and hats. The sea stretches into the distance under a cloudy sky. Printed text at the bottom left reads "Fishing Rocks near Seaview," and numerical codes "2823." and "8213." appear in the lower right corner.
